  daemon <action>       Manage the mobilebuildmcp daemon

Options:
      --log-level               Set log verbosity level  [string] [choices: "none", "error", "warn", "info", "debug"] [default: "none"]
      --style                   Output style (normal is detailed; minimal is compact MCP-like output)  [string] [choices: "normal", "minimal"] [default: "normal"]
      --file-path-render-style  Render file artifacts as a compact tree or labeled list in text output  [string] [choices: "tree", "list"]
  -h, --help                    Show help  [boolean]
  -v, --version                 Show version number  [boolean]

Run 'mobilebuildmcp mcp' to start the MCP server.
Run 'mobilebuildmcp tools' to see all available tools.
Run 'mobilebuildmcp <workflow> <tool> --help' for tool-specific help.
